name: show_artifact
description: Display an existing HTML file in this conversation's live Servo artifact pane. First write the HTML file under /tmp, then pass its absolute path. The file is loaded in place so relative CSS, scripts and images resolve beside it. This is a real, unsandboxed browser: JavaScript and network requests execute. Returns the displayed browser ID and canonical file path, or a real file/runtime error. It does not create files or accept HTML source.

path.description: Absolute path to an existing HTML file, normally /tmp/artifact-name.html.

name: browser
description: Operate DROSTJE's real embedded Servo browser, not external Chrome. open creates a browser in this thread's sidebar or a dock tab and returns its ID; reuse that ID for all other actions. inspect reads current URL, title, loading/error and navigation state. evaluate executes JavaScript in the page and returns its actual result (use it to inspect DOM or select elements). click uses viewport CSS-pixel coordinates; type inserts text into the focused element; key sends a named keyboard key with optional modifiers; scroll sends wheel deltas at viewport coordinates. navigate/back/forward/reload change page navigation. screenshot saves the current rendered frame to an absolute PNG file path. close closes that browser. This browser is unsandboxed; page scripts and network requests execute. Loading and rendering are asynchronous: inspect reports current state and screenshot can fail before a frame exists. Missing runtimes, files, pages and execution failures are returned as errors, never simulated.

id.description: Browser UUID returned by open or show_artifact; required except for open.

url.description: URL for open or navigate. Supports http:, https: and file:.

placement.description: Where open displays the browser; defaults to sidebar.

script.description: JavaScript expression or script for evaluate.

x.description: Viewport x coordinate in CSS pixels for click or scroll.

y.description: Viewport y coordinate in CSS pixels for click or scroll.

key.description: DOM key for key, e.g. Enter, Tab, ArrowDown or a.

code.description: Optional DOM physical key code, e.g. Enter, Tab, ArrowDown or KeyA. Omitted means Unidentified.

path.description: Absolute output PNG path for screenshot.
